tibo.summary: Default speed ~50% faster across GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol for subscribers and Sign in With ChatGPT partners (OpenCode, Pi, Amp, Devin, etc.), no user action needed.

grokbot.summary: Grok Bot got a public changelog: every release since launch with what's new, improved and fixed, plus an RSS feed (x.ai/changelog/bot).

tibo.summary: Auto-review free for ChatGPT sign-ins.
Simpler API rate-limit tiers.
Meetings note-taker plugin.
Decisions API.

grokbot.summary: Tag @bot on X: reply to, post, or quote any post with an instruction (save to Notion, remind me, summarize, draft a reply) and it lands in your Grok Bot.

tibo.summary: GPT-6 with Intelligent UI rolled out to all ChatGPT users.
Codex Cloud silently re-shipped (late evening PT encore); Tibo says it's "pretty good now", quoting the new Codex Cloud + Tailscale tailnet integration.

grokbot.summary: Best model for each task: Grok Bot now routes to leading back-end models, with Claude Opus 5.5 rolling out (announced by Elon 11:46 PM PT Oct 6; poteto confirmed the rollout just after midnight PT).

Release 0.68.1: Bots build slide decks delivered as PowerPoint or Google Slides, formatted emails straight from a draft card, 1:1 chats take the Bot's color, faster computer use on a 1920x1200 screen.
Native X access: Grok Bot can now search, read, and monitor X, with no X account, API key, or connector needed.

tibo.summary: Instant steering: the model reacts much faster to adjustments and course-corrects in realtime without wasting effort.
GPT-6.1 Sol ultrafast rolling out in API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work (near-Astra intelligence at up to 8x Sol Standard).

grokbot.summary: Shopify connector: connect Shopify and have Grok Bot check orders, track inventory, and keep product listings up to date.

tibo.summary: Composer predictions in the Codex desktop app (beta): Codex suggests your next message based on the conversation and how you talk to it; included in Pro plans without consuming usage.
Dots edition: you can now create and text your dot entirely from the ChatGPT mobile app on iOS and Android.

grokbot.summary: Bot colors: a new setting that makes Grok Bot a lot more colorful (turn on bot color in settings).
Grok Bot now has its own email address it can use to sign up for services, contact businesses, or schedule time with someone.
Four new Grok Bot templates for building on X: launching, threat hunting, threat intel, and X API integration.

tibo.summary: Global usage reset for everyone (propagated by end of day).

grokbot.summary: Removed the 50-bot cap on how many Bots you can have.
Fixed a bug where external app links didn't work in Grok Bot.

tibo.summary: Default context length for GPT-6.1 Sol increased to 500k when used through Codex & Work, up from 272k (~80%). It reduces compactions and helps tasks that need a lot of context and nuance over time; carefully tested as the new sweet spot, still overridable higher or lower, with a 1M maximum.
No long-context fees for GPT-6.1 Sol when drawing usage from the subscription (with the new 500k default through Codex & Work).

grokbot.summary: Release 0.70.2: fixed Grok Bot falsely treating the Mac mini / desktop client as offline when it was still awake; rolling out now.

tibo.summary: Global usage reset for everyone, landing by end of day PST; Tibo later confirmed "It's done."
ChatGPT & Codex desktop apps now store state on disk more efficiently, cutting the amount stored on disk by about 60%; a small ship aimed at power users running out of disk space.
Global usage reset (Day 10/ Reset); Tibo confirmed "Done and dusted."

grokbot.summary: Grok Voice 3.0, SpaceXAI's new speech-to-speech model, now powers Grok Bot's voice mode (responds in under a second).
Official Basecamp connector for Grok Bot launched (connect via Connect Apps and search Basecamp).
Plus aliases for Grok Bot email: send and receive on dedicated aliases, or run routines that only fire for mail to a specific alias.

tibo.summary: Landed compute and product changes that very significantly decrease "Selected model is at capacity" errors; when it still happens, the request should eventually continue on its own instead of blocking.
Improvements to Codex & Work that increase the effective usage you get: context is reused across subagents, kept cached longer, and request routing is improved to raise cache hits.
GPT-6 Astra Pro in ChatGPT significantly improved for all Pro users: faster responses, better use of plugins and tools, and multiple agents working on parts of a task in parallel.
Dots now on your Home Screen (update your app to get it).

grokbot.summary: Cards in chat have a new design with a cleaner layout.
Refreshed look for Grok Bot with a new typeface and themes.
Grok Bot is much faster: computer tasks finish 3x sooner on average, and other replies arrive in less than half the time.
Notifications now go only to the device you're using.
Grok Bot can now read X Chat: connect X, then ask Bot to work across your messages.
New connectors for Robinhood, Coinbase, Trello, PostHog, beehiiv, eToro and more; teams can now submit connectors to the Grok Bot marketplace.

tibo.summary: Global usage reset for everyone (Day 13 / limit reset), landing sometime today by end of day PST.
Small quality of life improvement: you can now edit previous messages within a thread in the desktop app.
Global usage reset for everyone ("we're still cooking... and reset. Enjoy.").

grokbot.summary: Set Grok Bot as your iPhone's Action Button and press it to talk with Bot.

tibo.summary: Prompt caching for 12 hours in the API, and for logged-in users across Codex & Work the cache is kept forever, so resuming an old conversation always hits the cache with no penalty.

grokbot.summary: Easier to find, access, and edit the things Bot is doing for you in the right panel.

tibo.summary: Day 17 usage reset for everyone ("Bet you thought we forgot, but no, it's reset day today.").

grokbot.summary: Grok Bot can now build Pages: reports, memos, and dashboards you can edit together with Bot or have Bot keep up to date.

tibo.summary: Day 18 usage reset for everyone, alongside Decisions API going GA, OpenResponses joining the Linux Foundation, performance improvements, and Uber going all-in on Codex & Work ("But yes… that’s a reset!").

grokbot.summary: Grok Bot can now use your 1Password account: approve the logins you want to share and Bot signs in for you (rolling out over the next few days).
Grok Bot can now use Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, and more apps on your phone (rolling out on iOS and Android).

tibo.summary: Small updates: calls connect much faster for Dots, changing reasoning mid-conversation in Codex & Work no longer invalidates the cache, and an updated Codex CLI.

grokbot.summary: Grok Bot can now save your logins, cards, and contact information: add them once and Bot securely remembers them.
Release 0.75.5 is stable: Bots forward email with the original formatting and attachments, and there are fewer approval cards for things you asked for.
New streaming dictation experience in Grok Bot, rolling out on mobile in version 1.18.

tibo.summary: Day 20 "Rest and reset": usage reset for everyone, to be fully propagated by midnight PST (confirmed later that night: "It is all propagated. Enjoy some mad codexing tomorrow.").
Day 21 usage reset for everyone ("Wonder what happens the remaining seven days. But today is a reset.").

GPT-6.1 Terra is back: OpenAI's first model significantly better at writing, personality and nuanced understanding of requests, very good at computer use, with 2X more usage than 6.1 Sol across API and subscriptions.

Day 23 usage reset for everyone, landing by midnight PST (he joked it was the much-requested iCloud Mail & Calendar plugins: "Just kidding, today is a reset."; confirmed later that night: "And it's done.").

grokbot.summary: Release 0.77.0 is stable: permission settings for your auto-review rules, pick which payment method Bots use first in the vault, and Bots can ask several questions on one card.

tibo.summary: Text your dot: give it a task by text, photos or voice notes over iMessage or RCS and it texts you back with proactive updates (preview for Pro users in the US).

grokbot.summary: Release 0.78.1 is stable: shopping results show up as product cards, new subscription templates, and you can connect Shop Pay in the vault.

tibo.summary: Doubled usage limits for all Pro 100/200/500 tiers and Business Premium, effective today; Pro 200 limits won't be reduced, and extended dot limits stay (separate from default usage).
